visibility.description: Release boundary for the entire holding. Use player_known only when all included details are established for the player; otherwise use gm_private.

known_by.description: Exact character identities that know this holding in the fiction. This does not override visibility or reveal private information to the player.

notes: Owner and holder/location reference persistent campaign entities or participants.
Quantities are whole units. Currency has a stable named identity; no exchange rate is inferred.
Distinct objects have at most one unit across all holdings of their item_id.
For a Ruleset holdings projection, use this schema as the inventory array items after removing only the $schema, $id and title documentation headers.

Ruleset inventory selection requires x-sylvia-gm-inventory. Shared bookkeeping uses format string_list or holdings; mechanic-owned equipment uses format mechanics with its own state {namespace, key}, declared surface_id and tool names. The latter must not also declare character bookkeeping. A panel name alone selects nothing.
file: Campaign State inventory holdings; Ruleset inventory field items
